description_en: Retrieves information from a specified knowledge base
description_zh: 在指定的知识库中检索信息
name: Retrieve

parameters.help_en: The input text, which is the original input prompt. The length and characters of Query are not limited
parameters.help_zh: 输入文本（原始输入prompt）。Query的长度和字符没有限制
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en:
The top K value for AISearch. The system generates a vector for the input text and retrieves the top K text chunks in the knowledge base that are most similar to the vector representation. Valid values: 0 to 100.
The sum of DenseSimilarityTopK and SparseSimilarityTopK must be less than or equal to 200.

Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
向量检索 Top K，通过生成输入文本的向量并在知识库中检索与其向量表示最相似的 K 个文本切片。K的取值范围[0-100]。
`DenseSimilarityTopK`和`SparseSimilarityTopK`二者之和小于等于200。

默认值为100
parameters.name: dense_similarity_topk

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable reranking. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2807740.html. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled.

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启重排序。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2807740.html。取值范围：
true：开启。
false：不开启。

默认值为 true
parameters.name: enable_reranking

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable <props="china">multi-turn conversation rewriting (https://help.aliyun.com/model-studio/use-cases/rag-optimization#b7031e2ad6cji)</props><props="intl">multi-turn conversation rewriting (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/model-studio/use-cases/rag-optimization#b7031e2ad6cji)</props>.
Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启<props="china">多轮对话改写 (https://help.aliyun.com/model-studio/use-cases/rag-optimization#b7031e2ad6cji)</props><props="intl">多轮对话改写 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/model-studio/use-cases/rag-optimization#b7031e2ad6cji)</props>。
取值范围：
true：开启。
false：不开启。

默认值为 false
parameters.name: enable_rewrite

fields.help_en:
The specified reranking model. The value specified here overrides the reranking model selected when the knowledge base was created. Valid values:

<props="china">

qwen3-rerank-hybrid: qwen3-rerank (hybrid) reranking.
qwen3-rerank: qwen3-rerank reranking.
gte-rerank-hybrid: gte-rerank (hybrid) reranking.
gte-rerank: gte-rerank reranking.

</props>

<props="intl">

gte-rerank-hybrid: Official reranking.
gte-rerank: gte-rerank reranking.



</props>


Default value: null. The reranking model selected when the knowledge base was created is used.


<props="china">

If you only need semantic reranking, use qwen3-rerank. If you need both semantic reranking and text matching features to ensure relevance, use qwen3-rerank-hybrid.



</props>



<props="intl">

If you only need semantic reranking, use gte-rerank. If you need both semantic reranking and text matching features to ensure relevance, use gte-rerank-hybrid.



</props>



<props="china">

gte-rerank-hybrid and gte-rerank will no longer be updated and are not recommended.



</props>
fields.help_zh:
使用指定的排序模型。此处指定值将覆盖创建知识库时所选择的排序模型。取值范围：

<props="china">

qwen3-rerank-hybrid：qwen3-rerank(hybrid)排序。
qwen3-rerank：qwen3-rerank排序。
gte-rerank-hybrid：gte-rerank(hybrid)排序。
gte-rerank：gte-rerank排序。

</props>

<props="intl">

gte-rerank-hybrid：官方排序。
gte-rerank：gte-rerank排序。



</props>


默认值为空，使用创建知识库时选择的排序模型。


<props="china">

如仅需语义排序，可使用`qwen3-rerank`；若同时需要语义排序和文本匹配特征以确保相关性，建议使用`qwen3-rerank-hybrid`。



</props>



<props="intl">

如仅需语义排序，可使用`gte-rerank`；若同时需要语义排序和文本匹配特征以确保相关性，建议使用`gte-rerank-hybrid`。



</props>



<props="china">

`gte-rerank-hybrid`与`gte-rerank`后续停止更新，不建议使用。



</props>
fields.name: model_name

fields.example: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query.
fields.help_en:
<props="intl">This parameter is not available. Do not specify this parameter.</props>

<props="china">A natural language instruction used to fine-tune the behavior of the reranking model.
<notice>This parameter takes effect only when rerank_mode is set to custom.</notice></props>
fields.help_zh:
<props="intl">该参数暂不开放，请勿传入。</props>

<props="china">提供一个自然语言指令，用于精细化控制重排序模型的行为。
<notice>此参数仅在 rerank_mode 设置为 "custom" 时生效。></notice></props>
fields.name: rerank_instruct

fields.help_en:
<props="china">
The instruction intervention mode of the reranking model, which determines its scoring preference.

Valid values:

qa: (Default) Q&A mode. The model tends to assign higher scores to candidates that can directly answer the query. Recommended for Q&A scenarios.

similar: Similarity mode. The model tends to assign higher scores to candidates that are highly consistent with the query content. Recommended for matching and retrieval scenarios.

custom: Custom mode. The reranking behavior of the model is determined by the instruction in the rerank_instruct parameter.

</props>

<props="intl">This parameter is not available. Do not specify this parameter.</props>
fields.help_zh:
<props="china">
指定重排序模型的指令干预模式，以决定其评分偏好。

可选值：

qa:（默认值） 问答模式。模型倾向于为能直接回答查询（Query）的候选项赋予更高分。建议在问答场景使用。

similar: 相似模式。模型倾向于为与查询内容一致性高的候选项赋予更高分。建议在匹配检索场景使用。

custom: 自定义模式。模型的排序行为由 rerank_instruct 参数中的指令决定。

</props>

<props="intl">该参数暂不开放，请勿传入。</props>
fields.name: rerank_mode

parameters.help_en:
The similarity threshold. This threshold specifies the minimum similarity score allowed for recalled text chunks and is used to filter the text chunks returned by the ranking model. Only text chunks with a score greater than this value are recalled. Valid values: 0.01 to 1.00. This parameter has a higher priority than the similarity threshold configured for the knowledge base.

If no specific value is specified, the similarity threshold configured for the knowledge base is used by default
parameters.help_zh:
相似度阈值。该阈值表示允许召回的文本切片的最低相似度分数，用于筛选Rank模型返回的文本切片，即只有分数超过此数值的文本切片才会被召回。取值范围[0.01-1.00]。此参数的优先级大于知识库相似度阈值配置。

当未指定具体值时，默认采用该知识库配置的相似度阈值
parameters.name: rerank_min_score

parameters.help_en: The top N text chunks to return after reranking. Valid values: 1 to 20. Default value: 5
parameters.help_zh: 重排序后的 Top N 返回数据。取值范围[1-20]，默认值为5
parameters.name: rerank_topn

fields.help_en:
The name of the multi-turn conversation rewriting model. The model automatically adjusts the original input prompt (user question) based on the conversation context to improve retrieval performance. Valid values:
conv-rewrite-qwen-1.8b: The conv-rewrite-qwen-1.8b model. Currently, only this model is supported.

Default value: null. The conv-rewrite-qwen-1.8b model is used
fields.help_zh:
多轮对话改写模型名称。它会基于会话上下文自动调整原始输入prompt（用户问题）以提升检索效果。取值范围：
conv-rewrite-qwen-1.8b：conv-rewrite-qwen-1.8b模型（目前只支持该模型）

默认值为空，采用conv-rewrite-qwen-1.8b模型
fields.name: model_name

parameters.help_en:
The top K value for keyword retrieval. The system retrieves chunks from the knowledge base that are an exact match for the keywords in the input text. This helps you filter out irrelevant text chunks and provides more accurate results.
Valid values: 0 to 100.
The sum of DenseSimilarityTopK and SparseSimilarityTopK must be less than or equal to 200.

Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
关键词检索TopK，即在知识库中查找与输入文本的关键词精确匹配的切片。它可以帮助您过滤掉无关的文本切片，提供更准确的结果。
取值范围[0-100]。
`DenseSimilarityTopK`和`SparseSimilarityTopK`二者之和小于等于200。

默认值为：100
parameters.name: sparse_similarity_topk

parameters.help_zh: 知识库所属的业务空间 ID。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html

Metadata.description_en:
<props="china">

The metadata map of the text chunk.

The file_path field in the metadata map of a document search knowledge base is meaningless. Do not use it in your business code.

When you retrieve a document search knowledge base, if a chunk contains an image, the image is returned in the image_url field of the metadata map, along with an expiration time.

When you retrieve an audio and video search knowledge base, if a chunk contains audio, the audio is returned in the audio_url field of the metadata map, along with an expiration time.

When you retrieve an audio and video search knowledge base, if a chunk contains a video, the video is returned in the video_url field of the metadata map, along with an expiration time.

</props>
<props="intl">

The metadata map of the text chunk.

The file_path field in the metadata map of a document search knowledge base is meaningless. Do not use it in your business code.

When you retrieve a document search knowledge base, if a chunk contains an image, the image is returned in the image_url field of the metadata map, along with an expiration time.

</props>
Metadata.description_zh:
<props="china">

文本切片的元数据Map。

文档搜索类知识库的元数据Map中`file_path`字段无意义，请勿在业务代码中使用。

检索文档搜索类识库时，若切片包含图片，将通过元数据 Map 中` image_url `字段透出，并附有过期时间。

检索音视频搜索类知识库时，若切片包含音频，将通过元数据 Map 中` audio_url `字段透出，并附有过期时间。

检索音视频搜索类知识库时，若切片包含视频，将通过元数据 Map 中` video_url `字段透出，并附有过期时间。

</props>
<props="intl">

文本切片的元数据Map。

文档搜索类知识库的元数据Map中`file_path`字段无意义，请勿在业务代码中使用。

检索文档搜索类知识库时，若切片包含图片，将通过元数据 Map 中` image_url `字段透出，并附有过期时间。

</props>
